claim_judgments.rationale: C0031 accurately combines and faithfully expresses the complete multi-part mandate imposed on a State under subsection (a) when an eligible entity fails to comply with agreement terms or standards, covering paragraphs (1) through (5) including reporting, discretionary quality improvement plan timelines, and hearing requirements prior to termination or reduction.
C0032 faithfully represents the first sentence of subsection (b), establishing that a State determination to terminate designation or reduce funding is reviewable by the Secretary.
C0033 accurately states the Secretary's obligation under subsection (b) to review such a determination upon request.
C0034 correctly states the requirement that the Secretary complete the review within 90 days after receiving all necessary documentation from the State.
C0035 faithfully records the statutory rule that if review is not completed within 90 days, the State's determination becomes final at the end of the 90th day.

C0036 accurately captures the Secretary's discretionary authority under subsection (c) to provide direct financial assistance to an affected eligible entity if a State violates section 9908(b)(8) assurances by prematurely terminating or reducing funding.

C0037 faithfully conveys the second sentence of subsection (c), requiring the reduction of the State's grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 by an amount equal to direct assistance funds provided.

unit_judgments.rationale: The requirement to inform the entity of the deficiency is fully captured within the comprehensive scope and text of C0031.
The requirement to require the entity to correct the deficiency is fully covered by item (2) in C0031.
The requirement to offer training and technical assistance if appropriate and report to the Secretary is fully covered by item (3)(A) in C0031.
The alternative requirement to submit a report stating reasons when training and technical assistance are determined not appropriate is fully covered by item (3)(B) in C0031.
The State's discretionary option to allow development and implementation of a quality improvement plan within 60 days is preserved in item (4)(A) of C0031.
The requirement to approve or specify reasons within 30 days after receiving a proposed plan is retained in item (4)(B) of C0031.
The requirement to initiate proceedings to terminate designation or reduce funding after notice and hearing unless corrected is retained in item (5) of C0031.
Jointly covered by C0032 (reviewability of State determination) and C0033 (duty of the Secretary to review upon request).
The 90-day deadline for completing the Secretary's review following receipt of all documentation is fully covered by C0034.
The finality of the State's determination at the end of the 90th day if review is not completed is fully captured in C0035.
The Secretary's authority to provide direct financial assistance until the violation is corrected is fully captured in C0036.
The mandatory offset reduction against the State's grant or allotment for the earliest appropriate fiscal year is fully captured in C0037.
